# Wrap Angle

![Wrap Angle function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/geometry/wrap_angle.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Wraps after unit conversion. Positive range uses the documented floor rule; signed endpoint choice is explicit GS. NI I32 units 0 rad/rad, 1 rad/deg, 2 deg/deg, 3 deg/rad. U16 range 0 none, 1 signed (default), 2 positive. GS endpoint choices (-half-turn,half-turn] and [0,full-turn). Finite DBL only; array operands have equal lengths.
